acceptanceCriteria: City, Forest, Grib, Laguna and Monument reconstruct from guide-contour fragments with no visible gaps, guide-colour pixels or unassigned source pixels.
Every rebuilt fragment has a same-size binary collision mask, a transparent RGBA visual, and a two-times-resolution individual quality pass.
Kraken retains its existing segmentation and masks while its three visuals receive the same quality pass.
nonGoals: Do not modify Desert Sci-Fi, gameplay geometry, camera behaviour or Kraken collision masks.
Do not manufacture final Robots or Vines assets from their red-marked images without a clean source master.

firstSlice.outcome: City is rebuilt as five red-guide-enclosed fragments that exactly reconstruct its clean master.
firstSlice.verification: Run source coverage, alpha, pair-dimension and dark/light/blue composite checks for the City output.
